title: Running LLMs on your iPhone: 40 tok/s Gemma 4 with MLX — Adrien Grondin, Locally AI
talk_summary: A short demo of running quantized Gemma models on-device on iPhone via Apple's MLX Swift LM framework, pulling quantized weights from the Hugging Face MLX community. The only transferable content is general guidance on quantization levels and the existence of a local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible model server (LM Studio).

takeaways.what_they_do: They pick quantized model variants (4-bit to 8-bit) rather than full precision, and treat sub-4-bit as a quality cliff for small models.
takeaways.evidence_quote: under like 4-bit it's getting it's starting to get a lot of impact on the output... 4-bit is the lower I would go
takeaways.numbers: 4-bit to 8-bit recommended range; ~40 tok/s on latest iPhone with Gemma 4 4-bit

takeaways.what_they_do: LM Studio can host local models and expose an OpenAI- or Anthropic-shaped streaming API that apps point at instead of a cloud endpoint.
